name: Green curry fried rice with chicken
notes: Rachel Cooks Thai green curry fried rice: for 4 plates 1 tbsp paste, 1 cup chicken, 1/2 cup coconut milk, 1/2 tbsp sugar, 1/2 cup long beans, 1/2 cup bamboo shoots, 3 cups cooked rice; scaled to a 190 g rice plate with the paste at 10 g (her tablespoon is 17 g), which suits the sweeter restaurant version. 10 g of oil.
